content.caption: WikiSkill framework overview: a three-layer workspace (skills, wiki, raw traces) linked to a four-step evolutionary loop of inference, wiki maintenance, skill proposal, and gated rollback.
content.description: A framework diagram with three stacked gray layers at the top. The Skill Layer (skills/) holds Evolving Procedural Knowledge and is marked Reversible, Conditional Update. The Wiki Layer (wiki/) holds Structured Patterns & Evolution Logs and is marked Compounding, Never Reset. The Raw Layer (raw/) holds Immutable Execution Traces and is marked Permanent, Write Once. Below the layers, four colored boxes are connected left to right by arrows. Step 1, Inference Agent (blue), executes rollouts on the training set; skills are injected into it from the Skill Layer and it writes traces to the Raw Layer. Step 2, Wiki Maintainer (red), samples traces from the Raw Layer, performs root-cause analysis on them, and consolidates patterns into the Wiki Layer. Step 3, Skill Proposer (yellow), reads skills, wiki content, and traces, and proposes skill updates from the wiki and traces. Step 4, Gating & Rollback (green), evaluates the skill candidate on the validation set, updates the skill only if it performs better, and updates the wiki logs. A green 'Next Iteration' arrow runs from Step 4 back to Step 1.
